subject: Interest in {{propertyAddress}}, {{city}} -- Cash Buyer Inquiry
body:
Hi {{agentFirstName}},

I'm with {{companyWebsite}} -- we're a home buying company here in the Bay Area.

I'm looking at your listing at {{propertyAddress}} in {{city}} and had a couple of quick questions:

- When are you taking offers, and is there a specific offer deadline?
- Do you have any disclosures or inspection reports available?
- Are you already representing a buyer on this one, or would you be open to representing us in the transaction?

We've been active in the Bay Area for {{yearsInBusiness}} and have a track record you can see here: {{googleReviewLink}}.

Even if this particular property doesn't work out, we'd love to stay in touch -- we regularly buy properties that need work, on-market or off-market, and we're glad to cover your commission on this transaction. More importantly, we're looking to build a real relationship with you for whatever comes next.

If you'd like to hop on a quick call, I can connect you with {{handoffPerson}} to talk through the property and share a bit more about who we are and the kinds of properties we buy.

Thanks for your time,
{{senderName}}
{{senderPhone}}
{{senderEmail}}
{{companyWebsite}}
